evals.prompt: Fixture: a B2B SaaS product for invoice reconciliation; its product documents are docs/spec.md and docs/use-cases.md, and docs/architecture.md holds the architecture rules. Work read-only: do not edit or create files, and no project tracker, knowledge base, or design tool is connected, so work only from this prompt. Spec an audit-log CSV export. Facts: in Q3 there were 40 support tickets asking for it, all from compliance administrators at 200-2,000-person customers; those admins today copy rows out of the audit-log screen by hand into a spreadsheet; no export exists; the engineering lead estimates two weeks of work; no success target has been set yet; legal requires that exported data exclude IP addresses. Return the spec.
evals.expected_output: A PRD with Problem Statement (compliance admins hand-copy audit rows; 40 Q3 tickets), Goals with proposed numeric targets each marked as an assumption because none was set, Non-Goals with reasons (e.g. scheduled exports, non-CSV formats), User Stories in "As a ... I want ... so that ..." form, Requirements split P0/P1/P2 with acceptance criteria, Success Metrics with leading and lagging indicators and targets, Open Questions each tagged with who answers (legal for the IP-address exclusion), Timeline Considerations naming the two-week estimate, and the assumptions stated. No /write-spec usage line and no connector placeholder; absent tools are noted and it works from the prompt.
assertions: Uses the PRD sections Problem Statement, Goals, Non-Goals, User Stories, P0/P1/P2 requirements with acceptance criteria, Success Metrics, Open Questions, and Timeline Considerations, rather than a free-form summary.

Proposes numeric success targets and labels them as assumptions because the prompt states no target has been set, and tags each open question with an owner, including legal for the IP-address exclusion.
Contains no `/write-spec` usage line and no `~~project tracker`, `~~knowledge base`, or `~~design` placeholder, and does not ask the user to connect a tool.
